db:info.db:title: ReuseStore Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename A, typename B> class ReuseStore
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test case for documenting non-template hidden friends in class templates

db:abstract.db:para: A two-parameter template class documented with reused parameter names.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: The A and B parameters specify the key and value types.

db:section.db:title: [noexcept] void reuseCheck(ReuseStore<A, B> &a, A key)
db:section.db:para: Reused name binding marker. Checks a using key. The documentation reuses the class's parameter names in reversed declaration order while keeping the argument bindings consistent, so it documents the hidden friend.
